criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: Play a song, album, artist, genre, era, or playlist, optionally specifying platform, popularity, recency, or sorting.

categories.name: Add to Music Playlist
categories.definition: Add a song, album, or artist to an existing music playlist.

categories.name: Find Music
categories.definition: Search for a specific song, album, or soundtrack.

categories.name: Play TV Show
categories.definition: Play a specific TV show or episode.

categories.name: Get Movie Showtimes
categories.definition: Inquire about movie schedules, including specific movies, genres, theaters, times, or locations.

categories.name: Find Movie Theater
categories.definition: Locate a movie theater, optionally specifying a movie or proximity.

categories.name: Find Creative Work
categories.definition: Search for a specific book, movie, TV show, trailer, or other creative work, excluding music and games.

categories.name: Book Restaurant
categories.definition: Make a reservation at a restaurant, specifying details like party size, date, time, location, cuisine, or specific restaurant.

categories.name: Find Restaurant
categories.definition: Search for a restaurant based on criteria like type, cuisine, location, amenities, dietary needs, or popularity.

categories.name: Manage Reservation
categories.definition: Modify an existing reservation, such as adding or removing guests.

categories.name: Get Weather Forecast
categories.definition: Inquire about weather conditions, temperature, or general forecast for a specific location, time, or date.

categories.name: Rate Media
categories.definition: Assign a rating or score to a book, album, movie, essay, series, or other creative work.

categories.name: Find Product
categories.definition: Search for a specific item to purchase or acquire.

categories.name: Find Image/Information
categories.definition: Search for an image or general information about a topic.

categories.name: Play Game
categories.definition: Launch or play a specific video game.

categories.name: Find Game
categories.definition: Search for a specific video game.
